part.text:
Fixed the nested/fallback router panic in `axum/src/routing/path_router.rs`.

`store_nested_matched_path` now always removes an existing `MatchedPath` instead of asserting it was absent. A fallback router can legitimately enter a nested service with an existing match extension; clearing it restores the intended nested matched-path state and prevents the `ServeDir` request panic.

Validation passed in the provided container:

- `cargo test -p axum routing::tests::fallback::doesnt_panic_if_used_with_nested_router`
- `cargo test -p axum routing::tests::fallback` (16 passed)
- `git diff --check`
